Although these songs were initially recorded in 1999, originally as part of Zubeen's second Bengali album, they were never made available to the public. This was his only Bengali album featuring Sagarika, where they performed only duet song titled "Jhiri Jhiri Ei Borosha", and it stands as one of the few Zubeen songs that went unreleased. Subsequently, it has occasionally appeared in bootleg or demo tapes.
